notes: Animated conic-gradient border wrapper. Slot-based. Single-spin on hover: 360° then lands on first colour. Pass 2-7 colours via array — defaults to full rainbow (CVD-safe, dark-mode-aware). First colour is static/landed state. Respects hover gate and render mode.

variant.description: Animation style. Primary: solid to gradient. Gradient: static gradient to rotating. Pulse: rotation + brightness.

borderRadius.description: Border radius. CSS value or token.

rotationSpeed.description: Rotation speed in ms per frame. Lower = faster. Ignored when data-hover is none/instant.

colour._description: Gradient colours — 2-7 stops. First colour is also the static/landed border. Defaults to full ROYGBIV rainbow (CVD-safe via rainbow tokens).

colors.description: Gradient colour stops. Evenly distributed. First colour wraps to end for seamless spin. Pass 2 for a simple duo-tone, 7 for full rainbow.
